newsitem.title: UK: Britain's Charles not planning to re-marry - paper.
newsitem.headline: Britain's Charles not planning to re-marry - paper.

text.p: Prince Charles, the heir to the British throne, has no current plans to marry his lover Camilla Parker Bowles, The Express newspaper reported on Tuesday.
The report said Charles had promised his mother Queen Elizabeth that he would not risk a constitutional crisis by forcing the issue of re-marriage.
"Marriage is simply not on his agenda at the moment," a senior Buckingham Palace figure was quoted as saying.
"They (Charles and Camilla) certainly love each other but equally they have no intention of doing anything that will damage the monarchy or cause a constitutional crisis."
But the unidentified palace aide added that marriage at some time in the future was not out of the question.
Charles has recently been taking steps to give Camilla greater public exposure as the woman in his life.
But many Britons blame her for the break-up of Charles' 15-year marriage to Princess Diana and say they could never accept Camilla, who is also divorced, as their queen.
